checkIn(uint256,bytes32).details: If the organiser withholds codes for the entire event, checkedInCount stays 0, which is below the 5% rescue threshold. All attendees can then call reclaimStake() after the rescue window to recover their full stake. This means the organiser cannot profitably withhold codes - they would forfeit their 80% organiser share without gaining anything.

checkIn(uint256,bytes32).notice: The organiser's QR code for each attendee encodes keccak256(secret || attendeeAddress). This binds the code to the attendee, preventing mempool front-running.
